name: Hytek Live Rosin | Oishii
description:
The Cap Junky is super potent and bright! It makes me think of apricot jam, with a hint of menthol on the back end. Have the pizza delivery on speed dial because the munchies are gonna smack you in the face.

Category: Hybrid

Breeder: Seed Junky x Capulator

Cross: Alien Cookies F2 x Kush Mints 11

Type: Rosin (1g)
